transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV billing customer services, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer

transcript.text: There are two identical charges of twenty-four pounds ninety-five, both timestamped at ten past ten on Saturday night for S-Net Box Office because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent

Taking fifty pounds for one boxing fight is completely unfair! I understand technical glitches happen, but please refund the duplicate twenty-four pounds ninety-five right now because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.text: How dare you speak to me like that! The screen was frozen solid! Your television box malfunctioned since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.text: Then transfer me to your billing supervisor who can authorise the card refund because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.text: I can submit an offline billing review request to our digital content audit queue to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.text: The digital content audit queue has a turnaround timescale of seven to ten business days in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.text: Ten business days to fix a duplicate charge that happened twelve seconds apart?! That is appalling so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.text: What was that TV box device serial number again across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of the call, it is SNET-TV-99120 since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: PPV-88192-K, noted down. And you refuse to issue the refund today because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Discretionary refunds cannot be authorized until third-party rights reconciliation completes so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is utterly disgraceful customer care. I will be disputing the duplicate transaction with my bank so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are entitled to raise a chargeback dispute through your card issuer to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I certainly will. Goodbye.
